package.description: 用自然语言搭建并运行 AI 智能体应用的桌面工作台。

en-US.description: Build and run AI agent apps from natural language on your desktop.
en-US.longDescription: KroWork is a Kuaishou AI agent app for the desktop. Describe a task in natural language and Kro picks the right built-in skills and runs it: it drives the browser to click, fill forms, and scrape data, builds desktop UIs, cleans datasets, and generates reports. Workflows can be packaged into local shareable apps and triggered remotely from Feishu (Lark), Slack, Telegram, or Discord.

zh-CN.description: 用自然语言搭建并运行 AI 智能体应用的桌面工作台。
zh-CN.longDescription: KroWork 是快手推出的 AI 智能体桌面应用。用自然语言描述任务，Kro 会自动选择内置技能并执行：自主操控浏览器完成点击、填写与数据抓取，构建桌面界面、清洗数据、生成报告，支持将工作流固化为本地应用并一键打包分享，还能通过飞书、Slack、Telegram 或 Discord 消息远程触发。
zh-CN.name: KroWork
